title: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
title_zh: RealMe：从极简采集实现沉浸式体积视频

paragraphs.en: RealMe利用高分辨率视频扩散模型将稀疏低分辨率采集增强为2K、4D一致的沉浸式体积视频。 This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.
paragraphs.zh: RealMe利用高分辨率视频扩散模型将稀疏低分辨率的采集资源增强为2K、4D一致的沉浸式体积视频。本文研究从稀疏且低分辨率的采集资源创建沉浸式体积视频的问题。 传统的稠密多视角重建方法能够生成高质量的体积视频，但其对昂贵采集设备的依赖使其在真实场景中难以实用。 近期的方法利用生成模型来放宽采集要求，但仍受限于分辨率低和4D不一致的问题。 为克服这些限制，我们提出了RealMe，一个以高分辨率视频扩散模型为核心的统一框架，它能将有限的采集增强为高分辨率（2K）、4D一致的视频，用于体积视频重建。 具体而言，RealMe从采集视频中构建辅助数据，并将其与布局感知的位置编码一同编码到潜空间中。 该视频扩散模型将因式分解的时空注意力适配到多视角采集布局上，跨视角和时间对潜变量进行去噪，并将其解码为增强后的视频，以精化4D表示。 这种适配有助于模型捕捉时间动态和多视角关系，从而实现更具4D一致性的生成。 为缩小生成视频与真实采集之间的数据差距，我们引入潜空间频率损失，在潜空间中提供频域监督。 在公开的DNA-Rendering基准和我们自采的RealVV数据集上的大量实验表明，RealMe能够创建沉浸式体积视频，并在视觉保真度和4D一致性方面优于最先进的方法。
